memberdef.name: json_tree_foreach_entry_preorder
memberdef.initializer: for ((pos) = json_tree_preorder_next_entry((root), (root), \ type, member); \ (pos) != NULL; \ (pos) = json_tree_preorder_next_entry((root), &(pos)->member, \ type, member))

memberdef.name: json_tree_foreach_entry_postorder
memberdef.initializer: for ((pos) = json_tree_postorder_next_entry((root), NULL, \ type, member); \ &(pos)->member != (root); \ (pos) = json_tree_postorder_next_entry((root), &(pos)->member, \ type, member))

briefdescription.para: Container-aware version of json_tree_foreach_postorder().

memberdef.name: json_tree_foreach_entry_safe
memberdef.initializer: for ((pos) = json_tree_postorder_next_entry((root), NULL, \ type, member); \ &(pos)->member != (root) && \ ((tmp) = json_tree_postorder_next_entry((root), &(pos)->member, \ type, member)) != NULL; \ (pos) = (tmp))

memberdef.name: json_tree_lookup

briefdescription.para: Look up a token in a JSON tree given a parent token and a key.
Insert a token into a JSON tree at a given position.

detaileddescription.para: The token key (json_token::type and num/str,len) must be set, e.g. by json_lexer_next_token(). The caller must ensure that no token with the same key is linked to the same parent, e.g. with json_tree_lookup().
Returns 0 on success, -1 on memory allocation error.

memberdef.name: json_tree_lookup_path

briefdescription.para: Look up a token in a JSON tree by path.

detaileddescription.para: The path is relative to the given root token. In order to look up a token by absolute path, pass json_tree::root. The index_base is passed to json_lexer used for tokenizing the path, see json_lexer_create() for more details.
Returns NULL if no token is found or the path is invalid.
